Late spring brings a memorable handover
Kudos to the whole team
Smooth paws and steady skies

This week at Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk kept things moving with the same calm care we like to see on every route. The welfare coordinator checked comfort notes, the ground team handled carriers with a gentle hand, and travelers appreciated the prompt updates that make busy days feel easier. <<FACT F037>> The tone across the desk stayed warm and practical, with everyone keeping an eye on comfort, clear records, and respectful follow-through.

The same steady rhythm carried through the handoff of pets from curb to cabin, and it showed in the little details that matter. <<FACT F036>> From careful routing to friendly check-ins, the team made sure each animal was treated like a valued traveler. It was a good reminder that small acts of care travel a long way, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping that standard in place for the days ahead.
